claims.evidence: The power cable is not shown, so the plug type cannot be confirmed.
The witness identified it as a game console but could not confirm the brand or model from the device.
No video or photo shows the console powered on or functioning.
The console is wrapped in plastic, hiding the actual surface condition.

risks.risk: Internal hardware failure (Blue Light of Death or overheating)
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen and running a game for 5 minutes.
A video showing a disc being inserted, read, and ejected.

risks.risk: Console is banned from PlayStation Network
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.
A photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.

proof_requests: Photo of the model and serial number sticker on the console.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a screen showing the system information.
Photos of the console with the plastic wrap removed to check for scratches or cracks.
Video of the disc drive in operation.
Photo of the second controller if it exists.
response.reason: The witness was unable to confirm the specific model or brand of the console, and the plastic wrap prevents a proper assessment of its physical condition.
